==English==
{{wp|<dab>}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:vewe|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|vewe}}, from {{der|en|xno|vewe}}, from {{der|en|fro|veue|g=f}} ({{cog|fr|vue|g=f}}), feminine past participle of {{m|fro|veoir|t=to see}} ({{cog|fr|voir}}). Cognate with {{cog|it|vedere}}, as well as Portuguese and {{cog|es|ver}}. {{doublet|en|veduta|vista}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/vjuː/|/vɪu̯/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-view.wav|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-view.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|uː|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}
[[Image:Vieux port Marseile.jpg|thumb|right|'''view''' of a city]]
[[File:View_from_a_room_in_the_Park_Hotel_Tokyo_in_Tokyo,_2019_-_331.jpg|thumb|right|'''view''' from a room]]

# {{lb|en|physical}} Visual [[perception]].
## The act of [[see]]ing or [[look]]ing at something.
##: {{ux|en|He changed seats to get a complete '''view''' of the stage.}}
##* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Regained|book=4|passage=Thenceforth I thought thee worth my nearer '''view'''.}}
##* {{RQ:Locke Human Understanding|}}, ''Book II, Chapter XXI''
##* {{RQ:Heyer Unknown Ajax|chapter=1
|passage=But Richmond {{...}} appeared to lose himself in his own reflections. Some pickled crab, which he had not touched, had been removed with a damson pie; and his sister saw, peeping around the massive silver epergne that almost obscured him from her '''view''', that he had eaten no more than a spoonful of that either.}}
## The [[range]] of [[vision]].
##: {{syn|en|sight|eyeshot}}
##: {{ux|en|If there are any rabbits in this park, they keep carefully out of our '''view'''.}}
##* {{RQ:Dryden Aeneis|passage=The walls of Pluto's palace are in '''view'''.}}
## Something to look at, such as [[scenery]].
##: {{syn|en|vista}}
##: {{ux|en|My flat has a '''view''' of a junkyard.}}
##: {{ux|en|the '''view''' from a window}}
##* {{RQ:Campbell Pleasures of Hope|passage='Tis distance lends enchantment to the '''view'''.}}
##* {{RQ:Lindsay Age of Consent|year=1962|page=20|passage="Well, there don't seem to be any what you might call '''views''' about here," he agreed. {{...}} "I've been through the Willawee Ranges forty miles west of here, and I can guarantee the '''views''' there."}}
## {{lb|en|Internet}} An individual viewing of a web page or a video etc. by a user.
##: {{ux|en|That video got a million '''views'''.}}
##: {{syn|en|pageview|q1=of a webpage|play|q2=of a video}}
##* {{RQ:Time|title=Who Is Balendra Shah, the Rapper On Track to Become Nepal’s Next Prime Minister|date=March 11 2026|author=Chad de Guzman
|text=His other song, “Nepal Haseko,” became an anthem during last year's protests, and already has more than 10 million '''views''' on YouTube.
|url=https://time.com/article/2026/03/11/balendra-shah-elections-nepal-prime-minister-rsp-gen-z-protests/
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260311233009/https://time.com/article/2026/03/11/balendra-shah-elections-nepal-prime-minister-rsp-gen-z-protests/}}
## {{lb|en|obsolete}} Appearance; show; aspect.
##* {{quote-book|en|year=c. 1648|author=w:Edmund Waller|title=The Night-Piece
|passage=[Graces] which, by the splendor of her '''view''' / Dazzled, before we never knew.}}
# A [[picture]], drawn or painted; a [[sketch]].
#: {{ux|en|a fine '''view''' of Lake George}}
# An [[opinion]], [[judgement]], [[imagination]], [[idea]] or [[belief]].
## A [[mental]] [[image]].
##: {{ux|en|I need more information to get a better '''view''' of the situation.}}
##* {{RQ:Shakespeare Troilus and Cressida|V|v|passage=I have with exact '''view''' perused thee, Hector.}}
## {{senseid|en|opinion}} A way of [[understand]]ing something, an [[opinion]], a [[theory]].
##: {{syn|en|conclusion|mind|take|Thesaurus:judgement}}
##: {{ux|en|Your '''view''' on evolution is based on religious doctrines, not on scientific findings.}}
##* {{RQ:Locke Human Understanding|2|21
|passage=to give a right '''view''' of this mistaken part of liberty}}
##* {{RQ:Guardian|date=May 30 2019|author=Karen Weintraub|title=Crispr gene-editing will change the way Americans eat – here's what's coming
|passage=There hasn’t been much polling data on consumer '''views''' of gene-edited foods, because they are still so new.
|url=https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/may/30/crispr-gene-edited-food-technology-us-produce|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261022232608/https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/may/30/crispr-gene-edited-food-technology-us-produce|archivedate=22 October 2026}}
## A [[point of view]].
##: {{ux|en|From my '''view''' that is a stupid proposition.}}
##: {{ux|en|I think I have fairly broad '''view'''s [[on the whole]].}} 
## An [[intention]] or [[prospect]].
##: {{ux|en|He smuggled a knife into prison with a '''view''' to using it as a weapon.}}
##* {{RQ:Locke Conduct|passage=No man ever sets himself about anything but upon some '''view''' or other which serves him for a reason for what he does}}
##* {{quote-book|en|year=1903|author=Henry Kelsall Aspinall|title=Birkenhead and Its Surroundings|page=116
|passage=With this '''view''', they made a Guy Faux, or dummy figure of a boy, dressed in coat and cap; such as might in a poor light be mistaken for a living figure.}}
# {{lb|en|computing|databases}} A [[virtual]] or [[logical]] [[table]] [[compose]]d of the result set of a [[query]] in [[relational]] [[database]]s.
# {{lb|en|computing|programming}} The part of a computer [[program]] which is [[visible]] to the user and can be [[interact]]ed with.
# A [[wake]]. {{rfex|en}}

{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[look at]].
#: {{ux|en|Reporters '''viewed''' a private screening of the upcoming film.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:Chicago Tribune|title=Stolen ashes returned after car taken with 15-year-old son’s remains inside|date=September 9 2026|author=Tess Kenny
|text=Within hours, the post circulated widely. As of Tuesday night, more than 111,000 people had '''viewed''' the video, with nearly 1,500 comments from people offering condolences, support and help.
|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/09/09/stolen-ashes-returned/|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260911074637/https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/09/09/stolen-ashes-returned/|archivedate=11 September 2026}}

#: {{ux|en|I '''view''' it as a serious breach of trust.}}
